title: Death of Frédérick Guay: the police officer who fired will not be prosecuted
article: No criminal charges will be brought against the Sûreté du Québec officer who shot Frédérick Guay on May 6, 2012, in Saint-Félicien.
The incident occurred at 2163 Chemin de la Pointe, in the Saint-Méthode area.
The death of the 35-year-old man was confirmed at the hospital.

According to various witnesses interviewed by the media the day after the tragedy, Frédérick Guay was armed and was visibly in an altered state. He had threatened to kill people and to commit suicide.
The intervention by the Sûreté du Québec during part of the night ended with a fatal gunshot.

The investigation was carried out by the Québec City police. The Director of Criminal and Penal Prosecutions concluded that, under the circumstances, the officer acted appropriately for his own protection, that of the other officers, and of the nearby residents.
